# pdf.js (vendored)

The legacy build of `pdfjs-dist` 6.5.438 by Mozilla, Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`), copied as is:
`legacy/build/pdf.mjs` and `legacy/build/pdf.worker.mjs`. The parse tools of the base read PDF files with it, in Node,
without canvas: text with its position, outline, images. It runs nothing from the file it reads.
